title: Raakaasa
plot_overview: After a decade away, a man returns to his village hoping to find romance. His arrival inadvertently awakens an ancient darkness the villagers have long feared, and as the threat grows, love becomes dangerous and lives hang in the balance.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like romance mixed with supernatural danger and village folklore; not for you if you prefer lighthearted stories without dark threats or life-or-death stakes.
review_summary: Pros: romance and supernatural danger; village folklore; escalating stakes | Cons: familiar horror setup; romance turns deadly; tone may feel intense
